title: US general election — president, the full House, one third of the Senate; this calendar's furthest-out entry and, measured, its only reliably high-dispersion session
source: EST: the date is statutory and was COMPUTED, not fetched -- 2 U.S.C. section 7 fixes the federal election on the Tuesday after the first Monday in November of an even year; November 2028's first Monday is the 6th, so Election Day is Tuesday 2028-11-07. Re-derived independently by this lane on 2026-09-09 (weekday arithmetic over 1970-2030, reproducible in one line of node). Cross-checked by an IDENTITY rather than a second source: Veterans Day falls on a Saturday exactly when November 7 is the Tuesday after the first Monday, so every year in which this calendar's fed-board-closure rule fires (1972, 1978, 1989, 1995, 2000, 2006, 2017, 2023, 2028 -- enumerated by computation) has Election Day on Nov 7. Held estimate on the same mechanical count the sibling midterm-elections-2026-11-03 entry records and NOT on any doubt about the date: market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no member for a statute or an election authority, so there is no honest way to file this confirmed without a schema change out of this lane's scope. Date-certain, outcome-unknown. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE written by this event's own never-assessed initial research (2026-09-09), after reading the sole prior proposal `proposals/presidential-election-2028-11-07.from-fed-board-closure-2028-11-10.json`, which is now inert. The proposal's D+3-Friday framing is KEPT; its headline framing is SHARPENED by an independent measurement this lane ran on 24,788 S&P 500 daily bars (Yahoo ^GSPC, 1927-12-30 to 2026-09-08, fetched 2026-09-09). What the tape actually says about presidential elections, n=13 (1976-2024): DIRECTION IS NOTHING -- the 12-month post-election return averages +11.69% with 77% positive against an unconditional 1976-2026 baseline of +10.12% and 77% positive, i.e. the famous post-election-rally statistic IS unconditional drift, and the 13 outcomes scatter across the 4th to 97th percentile of that baseline. DISPERSION IS REAL -- the session after Election Day averages 1.694% in absolute terms against 0.766% for all November sessions (permutation P = 0.0029, 20k draws) and 9 of 13 moved at least 1.0% against a 24.5% November base rate (binomial P = 0.00084); it survives dropping 2008 (1.396%, P = 0.021, n=12) and it is presidential-specific (midterm D+1 absolute mean 1.127%, n=12). Mean signed D+1 is -0.324% with 46% positive: a big-move day with no side. This is a VOLATILITY fact recorded at D-790 and it licenses NOTHING -- symbols is empty, no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is calendar-keyed, no listed instrument this lane could reach quotes a 2028-11 expiry (cboe.com's futures JSON 403'd and Yahoo's SPX option chain 401'd, both recorded in the ledger's probe-ref blocked array), and the estimate label forbids date-keyed action. Impact is filed high to match the sibling midterm entry's tier and is now MEASURED rather than inherited: the dispersion result above is the justification. Corridor sweep run mechanically over all 925 tracked events and proposals: nothing within plus or minus 60 days except fed-board-closure-2028-11-10 at D+3.
